title: Mehlan Mehlan ya Bunayya ya Bunayya
body:
Karke ruqsat naujawaa bete ko bole shahe deen
Mehlan mehlan ya bunayya ya bunayya
Dekhte jaao hume mud mud ke beta baar baar, dil bohat hai bekarar aankh bhi hai ashk kaar, aye mere karyal jawaan aye mere karyal jawan, sar ke jaati hai mere paao tale se ab zameen, mehlan mehlan ya bunayya ya bunayya
Saath tum le jaa rahe ho baap ki aankho ka Noor, khalbe madar ka suroor hasrate hain chur chur, aye mere karyal jawaan aye mere karyal jawan, hai dhuwa sa har taraf kuch sujta humko nahi, mehlan mehlan ya bunayya ya bunayya
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum tumhari maa ko beta kis tarah samjhayenge, usko kya batlayenge laash kaise laaenge, aye mere karyal jawaan aye mere karyal jawan, dekh ker laashe pisar kyunker jiyegi dil hazeen , mehlan mehlan ya bunayya ya bunayya
Bin tumhare zindagani yeh jahan per khaak hai, gham se dil sad chaak hai sadma e ghamnaak hai, aye mere karyal jawaan aye mere karyal jawan, chodker tanha chale ho janib e quld e bareen, mehlan mehlan ya bunayya ya bunayya
Aakhri karlu ziyarat Ahmed e muqtar ki, husn ke shahkar ki hai tadap deedar ki, aye mere karyal jawaan aye mere karyal jawan, phir nazar aayega duniya mein kaha tumsa haseen, mehlan mehlan ya bunayya ya bunayya
Jaa ke ran me apne seene per seena khaoge tum, humko tadapaoge tum sabko rulwaoge tum, aye mere karyal jawaan aye mere karyal jawan, khainchni hai ab seena humko ulat ker aasteen , mehlan mehlan ya bunayya ya bunayya
<<DIVIDER>>
Tha hasan sheh ke labon per ek fiqra baar baar, aye mere dul dul sawaar teri nusrat ke nisar, aye mere karyal jawaan aye mere karyal jawan, waqt e ruqsat bas yeh nauha padh rahe the shahe deen, mehlan mehlan ya bunayya ya bunayya
